title: Counting coins
examples: Teacher, how many coins make ten?
If I have a five and a one, what is the total?
Can we count these coins together?

explain.say: Today we are learning about different coins.
The one coin is worth just one unit.
The two coin is worth two units altogether.
A five coin is worth five units, look at it.
The ten coin is worth ten units, that is big.
If we put a two coin and a five coin together, we get seven.

faq.q: How do I know which coin is which?
faq.a: The coins look different and have different numbers on them. You can look closely at the pictures.
asks: How can I tell them apart?

faq.q: If I have two five coins, is it ten?
faq.a: Yes, two five coins make ten units. You count five, then you count another five.
asks: Can two fives make a ten?

faq.q: Do I always count from the biggest coin first?
faq.a: It is easiest to count from the biggest coin to the smallest one. This helps you keep track.
asks: What is the best way to count?
Should I start with the ten coin?

faq.q: Is adding coins like adding toys?
faq.a: Yes, it is like counting toys. You put them together to see the total amount.
asks: Do I count them all together?

faq.q: What if I have a one, a two, and a five?
faq.a: You count them one by one: one, then two, then five. The total is eight.

facts: A one coin is worth one unit.
A two coin is worth two units.
A five coin is worth five units.
A ten coin is worth ten units.

quiz.say: If you have a five coin and a two coin, what is the total?
quiz.why: You count five, and then you count two more to get seven.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you only counted the biggest coin and forgot the smaller one.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you are adding the two coins together instead of adding them to the five coin.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you only counted the small coins and ignored the five coin.

quiz.say: What is the total value of a ten coin and a one coin?
quiz.why: You count ten, and then you count one more to get eleven.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you only added the two coins together.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you only counted the smallest coin.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you forgot to count the one coin you added.

quiz.say: If you combine two five coins, how many units do you have?
quiz.why: Five plus five equals ten, which is the value of the ten coin.

wrong.1: This is wrong because you only counted the smallest coin.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you only counted one of the two five coins.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you added the two coins and then added one more unit.
